note: Default thresholds are illustrative user assumptions (quality class user-assumption). Edit here or in the app; no code change needed.

requirements.label: Sun-visible share
requirements.rationale: Enough sunlit time for solar-powered surface operations.

requirements.label: Longest Sun obstruction
requirements.rationale: Darkness the lander must survive on battery and heaters.

requirements.label: Earth-visible share
requirements.rationale: Geometric DTE availability (not a link budget).

requirements.label: Longest gap without Earth
requirements.rationale: Onboard autonomy and data buffering duration.

requirements.label: Battery margin above floor (est.)
requirements.rationale: Minimum charge stays at least 10% of capacity above the DoD floor; 0 means brownout.
